purpose: Specifies the .doc_structure.yaml format that declares document locations and types for rules and specs, used by forge to resolve paths, review targets, and search index targets.
summary: Overview: project-level config declaring where documents live and their types, consumed by forge skills and resolve_doc_structure.py
Schema with rules and specs categories: root_dirs, doc_types_map, patterns.target_glob and patterns.exclude
root_dirs and doc_types_map semantics including glob support with * and ** and recommended doc_type names
doc_types forge resolves (requirement, design, plan, adr, glossary); missing declaration makes the skill stop, duplicates are ambiguous
patterns.exclude matching rules and the exclusion of plan from the search index while still resolving its location
Version management via a comment line in X.Y format with major and minor semantics
Samples: flat, feature-based, nested, and with-exclude structures
Consumer guide: resolve_doc_structure.py usage, Python import, and passing paths to the document search index
tasks: Resolving document paths for rules and specs
Setting up a project for forge
Configuring search index target paths and excludes
Updating the rules or specs document index
title: .doc_structure.yaml フォーマット仕様
